text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A after a large gain felt satisfying, but I should base future trades on expected returns and risk rather than the pleasure of locking in gains.","Losses feel especially painful, so I should avoid letting that discomfort keep me from reassessing a position objectively.","With only a few observations and no trades beyond one sale, I should not overinterpret short-term account swings; I can keep a long-term, diversified perspective and trade selectively."]}
